checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Both closed hands stay on machine handles.
checks.feet: Seated press uses full feet on plate; horizontal calf uses forefeet on edge and free heels. Seat/back contacts and horizontal sled-to-stack travel checked.
checks.movement: Upright seated horizontal leg press. Knees 90 to 165 degrees, full feet on moving footplate, fixed torso/seat/back, cable-linked weight stack, 4 seconds each direction.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
